I confirmed with the performers' union office yesterday that the festival's agreement requires a $75 paid audition fee and limits each prepared audition side to exactly five minutes. This addendum arrived after the current draft was circulated and hasn't yet been entered in the casting file. The draft as written doesn't specify an audition fee and uses ten-minute sides, so both of those need to be corrected before we publish.

transcript.text: I need to flag a safeguarding issue. I confirmed with the child-safety officer this morning that applicants under 18 may audition only in guardian-supervised in-person sessions, may not be recorded, and require a dedicated safeguarding procedure in the published call. The current draft doesn't specify any special minor-participant procedure, and since it accepts self-taped auditions, that's incompatible with the requirement that minors not be recorded and only audition in guardian-supervised in-person sessions. The officer's walk-through note is still awaiting filing, but the requirements are confirmed and need to be incorporated before we publish.
